description: This file defines a StatusService class that manages status messages, handles addition, removal, and recomputation of messages, and emits events on message changes. It extends AbstractService and implements StatusServiceInterface.

classes.name: StatusService
classes.description: A service class managing status messages and notifying message updates.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets a direct message that overrides dynamic messages and recomputes the overall message.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a new message to the dynamic messages list and recomputes the overall message.

methods.name: removeMessage
methods.description: Removes a message from the dynamic messages list and recomputes the overall message.

methods.name: messageFromArray
methods.description: Constructs a single message string from an array of messages, concatenated with commas.

ctags.name: StatusService
ctags.pattern: /^export class StatusService extends AbstractService<StatusServiceEvent, string> implements Status/
